entries.5b8f08ab655dee71: This is the cosmetics and other product sales business conducted by Pharmarise Co., Ltd., and the business of operating convenience stores and drugstores, among others. It sells products other than prescription drugs, including over-the-counter drugs, sanitary materials, cosmetics and daily necessities, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥8,042 million.
entries.69abfaf710272dd4: As of May 31, 2026, the company, a holding company, and 14 consolidated subsidiaries form the group, which conducts business with the pharmacy business at its core. The reportable segments are 4: the Pharmacy Business, the Merchandise Sales Business, the Medical Records Storage and Management Business and the Medical Mall Management Business.
entries.9aff4f4b83787628: Pharmarise Co., Ltd., Chemist Co., Ltd., Healthy Work Co., Ltd., Hokkaido Pharmarise Co., Ltd., GOOD AID Co., Ltd., next PH Co., Ltd., Taiyo Yakuhin Co., Ltd. and Heisei Yakuhin Ltd. operate pharmacies that dispense medicines to general patients based on prescriptions issued by medical institutions. The number of pharmacy stores at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year was 406, and revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥59,331 million.
